title: Local search
idea: Local search: Scoped query and contextual snippets lead file inspection
audience: People who need to find file within a desktop surface.
worksWellWhen: Users know fragments rather than exact paths
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic command layout through its find file priority and explicit commitment contract: Search never expands into unauthorized directories
navigation: Local search keeps the current find file context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Scoped query and contextual snippets lead file inspection
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to find file; users know fragments rather than exact paths
composition.priority: Search never expands into unauthorized directories

imagery.role: Support the actual find file context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Keep active filters adjacent to results when resized
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the local search structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no find file content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Search never expands into unauthorized directories
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized find file content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Search never expands into unauthorized directories
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active find file context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
